purpose: Teach: マッカーシー/シンドラー/テイラー/ペルシャ/月光/スクランブル/熱血/輝かしい

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマッカーシー時代のドキュメンタリー観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's watching a documentary about the McCarthy era.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost amused. Gentle lift at the end—inviting him into her mild wonder at what Dad's absorbed in today. Soft, unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「シンドラーのリスト」の映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched Schindler's List together!
lines.style: Bright rush of excitement, words tumbling slightly forward. Genuine pride in the accomplishment of having done something grown-up with Dad. Open, unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがエリザベス・テイラーの伝記を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's reading Elizabeth Taylor's biography.
lines.style: Gentle, observing tone. Slight wondering quality—the small fascination of noticing her husband's many interests. Measured pace, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとペルシャ絨毯の博物館行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to the Persian rug museum!
lines.style: Excitement breaking through clearly. The wonder of a strange and beautiful place experienced together. Words slightly bright and quick, almost breathless with the significance of the outing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが月光ソナタを聴いてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's listening to Moonlight Sonata.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation in the voice. A small, knowing smile audible. Soft and unhurried—the contentment of watching her husband lost in something beautiful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとスクランブルエッグの朝食食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I had scrambled eggs for breakfast today!
lines.style: Warm, straightforward brightness. The simple joy of sharing an ordinary moment with Dad. Natural enthusiasm without strain—a small thing made special by his presence.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「熱血スポーツ漫画」を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's reading a hot-blooded sports manga.
lines.style: Dry, affectionate amusement. The slight humor of noting Dad's eclectic tastes shifting again. Calm, even delivery with a gentle warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「輝かしい卒業の日」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me I had a brilliant graduation day.
lines.style: Soft wonder and quiet pride. The words almost reverent—repeating something precious Dad said. Slower pace, holding the moment gently. Small voice, big feeling.
